name: SUP6 single post support for a traffic sign up to 900 x 1000 mm (candidate)

notes: SUP6 titles the drawing 'SUPPORT FOR TRAFFIC SIGN' without a road-class restriction; the road classes here are the F0 face fixtures' classes, not a source statement.

attachments.name: ground
attachments.note: Top of the cement mortar / ground surface at the post; the concrete foundation extends 1000 mm below.

attachments.name: sign_bottom_edge
attachments.note: Printed label 2400 from ground to the bottom edge of the sign in the single post elevation.

attachments.name: face_back_centre_600_panel
attachments.note: 2400 (sign bottom, SUP6) + 300 (half of the 600 mm TFM1 backing height). Valid only for a 600 mm-high face fixed with its bottom edge at the labelled height. Not a printed dimension.

structure.post: SHS 50 x 50 x 5.0 THK hot dipped galvanised, sealed with rubber plug on top
structure.basePlate: 200 x 200 x 10 THK M.S. plate welded to SHS, 4 nos expansion bolts
structure.foundation: 500 x 500 x 1000 C16/20 concrete; cement mortar 300 x 300 x 75 (on footpath) or 450 x 450 x 75 (on foundation)
structure.signFixing: 4.8 dia rivets not more than 150 apart; aluminium flat stiffeners 50 from top and bottom edges (side elevation)

drawingSheet.title: SUPPORT FOR TRAFFIC SIGN (SHEET 3 OF 4)
drawingSheet.readFrom: title block rendered from the original PDF page 8

measurements.name: sign_bottom_above_ground
measurements.endpoints: ground surface to bottom edge of sign, single post support elevation
notes: Applies to the assembly drawn on SUP6 only; not a universal mounting rule.

measurements.name: sign_width_maximum
measurements.endpoints: left to right outer edge of sign, labelled 900 (MAXIMUM)

measurements.name: sign_height_maximum
measurements.endpoints: top to bottom outer edge of sign, labelled 1000 (MAXIMUM)

measurements.name: post_section
measurements.endpoints: outer face to outer face of the square hollow section (50 x 50 x 5.0 THK)

measurements.name: base_plate_size
measurements.endpoints: edge to edge of the square 200 x 200 x 10 THK M.S. base plate

measurements.name: foundation_depth
measurements.endpoints: top to bottom of the 500 x 500 x 1000 C16/20 concrete foundation
notes: Source transcription, not a structural design approval.

extractionRecipe.method: Hand transcription of printed dimension labels from the original SUP PDF (hash verified) into candidate metadata; no artwork generated.
extractionRecipe.tool: PyMuPDF page render for visual reading

warnings: The rear elevation is drawn from behind the sign; the drawing does not state which way the face points relative to the road. Face normal is a scenario decision, not a source fact.
The post top is hidden behind the sign in the elevation; total post height above ground is not dimensioned.
Engineering reference includes dimension leaders/labels; not cleaned production geometry.
Foundation and plate values are a source transcription, not a structural design approval.
